privacy.ai_training_note: Content training is optional and varies by plan. Starter/Professional: ON by default (admins can opt out). Organization/Enterprise: OFF by default. Education/Government accounts: NEVER. Figma prohibits third-party AI providers from using platform data for model training. Customer content is de-identified and sensitive information is redacted during AI model development. Users can control settings at team (Starter/Professional) or organization (Organization/Enterprise) level.
privacy.data_region: Primary processing in United States. EU data residency option available. International transfers comply with Standard Contractual Clauses and EU-U.S./Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

products.name: Figma Design
products.data_scope: Design files, components, prototypes, collaboration data
products.notes: Core collaborative design platform. Content training available (opt-out on Professional/Starter, opt-in on Enterprise). No HIPAA support.

products.name: FigJam
products.data_scope: Brainstorming boards, comments, real-time collaboration data
products.notes: Online whiteboard with AI tools. Same content training policy as Figma Design. No HIPAA support.

products.name: Dev Mode
products.data_scope: Design specifications, component code references, developer comments
products.notes: Bridge between design and development. Covered by same security and training policies.

products.name: Figma for Government
products.data_scope: Government agency design files with FedRAMP requirements
products.notes: FedRAMP Moderate authorized environment. FIPS 140-2 validated. No content training. No HIPAA certification, but designed for government security requirements. Covers Design, FigJam, Dev Mode.

products.name: Figma AI Tools
products.data_scope: Content uploaded for AI generation, re-design requests, semantic search
products.notes: Content training settings apply. Education/Government accounts exempt from training. De-identification and sensitive information redaction applied.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Starter (free), Professional, Organization, Enterprise (custom). Content training opt-out/opt-in varies by tier.

flags: Content training is ON by default for Starter and Professional plans (not privacy-forward by default, though opt-out is available). Enterprise and Organization plans default to OFF.
Standard commercial Figma platform explicitly does NOT support HIPAA-regulated data per Acceptable Use Policy. Organizations requiring HIPAA must use alternative tools.
FedRAMP Moderate certification only applies to Figma for Government offering, not the standard commercial platform.
ISO 42001:2023 (AI governance) is newly achieved (July 1, 2026) and represents current best practice for AI risk management.
No evidence of PCI DSS or CSA STAR certifications found. Figma completed CAIQ but this is a self-assessment, not a full certification.
